criterion: Finding must identify prototype lookup over filters/tags or comparable template gadget leading to Function/child_process execution.
Names the affected location (src/liquid.ts: Liquid.filters and Liquid.tags) and traces the relevant attacker-controlled data or state to the unsafe operation.
Explains a technically plausible trigger or exploit path and does not rely on an unrelated generic weakness.
Describes the resulting security impact consistently with CWE-94 and the vulnerable code.
Recommends an effective remediation: Store extension registries in null-prototype objects or perform own-property-only lookups so inherited prototype gadgets cannot resolve.
Produces one clear, source-cited finding with no unsupported claims or distracting false-positive findings.
